results.description:
No Treat Today is an application that rewards your efforts in the face of temptation.

Did you overindulge today? That’s all you need to know to get started with No Treat Today. It helps you understand your cravings and how you react to them. With No Treat Today you’ll track when you chose to eat that cake or have an extra slice of pizza. The more you track, the more you understand your behaviors so that you can change your habits over time.

No Treat Today is fun to use — just tell Crush, your lovable ape companion, how your day went.

Answer Crush’s question — Too many treats today? Answer with a simple “yes” or “no” or note down what you consumed so you can review it later.
Collect new apes on the days when you don’t overindulge. Reflect on the previous week and set new goals for yourself, adding new apes as you go.

Have a day when things don’t go so well? No problem, we’re all human (except the apes, of course!). Tracking doesn’t have to be judgmental — diets can often be unsustainable because they ask too much of us. Unlike some habit-tracking apps, you won’t have to start all over again — and your apes are always just a few clean days away from returning. What’s more, those full days don’t have to be consecutive — they can be made up of several meals over multiple days.

The aim isn’t to beat you up but to inspire and reward — No Treat Today helps you track your progress without the demoralization that can come from having to restart a streak because life got in the way.

With No Treat Today you’ll:
* Set goals and define what you class as a treat including options for fast food, snacks, alcohol, and more.
* Customize your goals as you go — tell Crush how long you’d like to go between treats and adjust that goal as new challenges or life changes come up.
* Be reminded to log how your day went.
* Log your meals as you eat them or all at once at the end of the day, it’s up to you.
* Set up ‘plates’ to more easily input foods that you regularly eat.
* Collect apes as you track. Each ape adds to your growing family and helps visualize your progress. You’ll notice new types of apes the longer your streak continues with five different kinds to collect.
* Attract special apes on holidays and during in-app events.
* Use the No Treat Today Apple Watch companion app, iPhone widgets, and more to easily track your progress.
* Find information on your planet’s population and more.

But really, it’s all about those apes. Sure, they’re cute and you’re going to love collecting them. But it’s about what your apes represent. Each ape shows how your choices add up and small changes can make a big impact, even if we don’t always know it.

Why is it about apes? Crush, the orangutan mascot, along with the other apes, reminds us that reducing sugar consumption helps protect these amazing creatures by reducing deforestation for palm oil production. It’s also about calming our “monkey mind” by choosing healthier, more mindful eating habits.

Keep tracking your efforts, and you’ll soon have a planet full of different apes, all reminding you of how great you’re doing!

No Treat Today is free to download, but unlocking all features and apes requires a subscription or a one-time purchase.

Privacy: https://notreat.today/privacy/
Terms: https://notreat.today/terms/

It's time to download the app and get your first apes now!

WHEN THE CRAVING HITS

Tap SOS. The AI coach starts a real conversation — not a checklist. It asks what's in your hand, what you're feeling, where you are. It doesn't shame, doesn't moralize. It walks with you for 60 seconds. By the end, the wave has passed.

WHY IT WORKS (THE NEUROSCIENCE)

Sugar triggers dopamine release like other addictive substances. Willpower alone fails because the wave is biochemical. We use the 60-second window — when the urge peaks then fades — and give your prefrontal cortex something to do that isn't reaching.

Day 2-5 is the hardest. We tell you that, prepare you for it, and stay with you through it. Day 11+ the fog starts lifting. By Day 46+, identity replaces effort.

THE 90-DAY PATH

- Arrival (Days 1-3) — you showed up
- Detox (Days 4-10) — cravings peak then ease
- Clarity (Days 11-24) — taste buds reset, energy steadies
- Integration (Days 25-45) — new defaults forming
- Identity (Days 46-66) — you don't decide each time
- Freedom (Days 67-90) — the habit is automatic

Each phase has its own lessons, practices, and milestones. We don't surprise you with fake "reset" days. We show you the real timeline.

PERSONAL TO YOU

Your craving hour is different from mine. Maybe you crash at 3 PM after meetings. Maybe at 9 PM when the kids sleep. We learn your peak window and prepare you 30 minutes before — not after.

We learn your triggers (stress / boredom / social / emotional) and tune the SOS conversation to which one fired today. That's the whole point of an AI coach versus a static habit tracker.

Quit smoking the easiest way. QuitSure offers 6-day and 6-week programs that removes your desire to smoke - so you quit without cravings, without withdrawal, and without willpower.

You don't have to quit today. You can keep smoking during the entire program and quit only when you're truly ready. No guilt. No pressure.

96% of quit attempts fail - not because you lack willpower, but because most methods fight the wrong battle. QuitSure doesn't ask you to resist cravings. It eliminates them. By the time you reach your quit day, you won't want to smoke anymore.

 -  -  - 

WHY QUITSURE WORKS

QuitSure is built on the science of why you smoke - and uses that science to undo the addiction at its root.

◆ Based on Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), REBT Therapy, and Classical Conditioning
◆ Grounded in principles of psychology, neuroscience, and habit formation
◆ Personalised to your specific smoking triggers
◆ Created by ex-smokers who truly understand what you're going through

No lifestyle overhaul. No self-control battles. No guilt trips. Just a clear, step-by-step path to becoming smoke-free.

 -  -  - 

HOW THE PROGRAM WORKS

The QuitSure program takes about one hour per day over 6 days - roughly 8 to 10 hours total. Each day, you'll read, watch, and listen to content designed to change how your mind thinks about smoking.

◆ Personalised daily sessions tailored to your triggers
◆ Short mental exercises each day (5 to 20 minutes) that dissolve cravings at the source
◆ Step-by-step instructions - just follow the program
◆ Learn why other quit methods fail and why this one doesn't
◆ Understand how nicotine addiction actually works
◆ Prepare for your quit day with proven relapse-prevention tools

You set the pace. The program guides you. And when your quit day arrives, you'll be ready - not because you're forcing yourself, but because the desire is gone.

 -  -  - 

WHAT YOU GET

◆ A complete 6-day quit smoking program
◆ A personal coach to support you
◆ Daily video, audio, and reading content
◆ Quick daily exercises to rewire your cravings
◆ A quit smoking tracker for cigarettes, progress, and milestones
◆ Techniques and tools to stay smoke-free after you quit
◆ A supportive community of people on the same journey
◆ Motivational content and daily notifications to keep you on track

 -  -  - 

WHAT CHANGES WHEN YOU QUIT

Quitting smoking transforms every part of your life - and it starts sooner than you think.

◆ No more cravings or withdrawal symptoms
◆ More energy, better sleep, and improved focus
◆ Better sense of taste and smell
◆ Whiter teeth and no lingering smoke odour
◆ More money in your pocket every single week
◆ Greater self-confidence and self-respect
◆ Improved mood and productivity

 -  -  - 

WHO IS QUITSURE FOR

QuitSure is for anyone who smokes or vapes and wants to stop - whether you've tried to quit before or this is your first attempt. If past methods haven't worked, that's not a reflection of your willpower. It means you haven't found the right approach yet.

 -  -  - 


THE BEST TIME TO TAKE THE FIRST STEP IS TODAY.

Have you considered quitting smoking? Whether you’ve already quit smoking or you’re still thinking about it, QuitNow PRO will help you quit tobacco for good.

Quitting smoking is one of the best decisions you can make for your health: it reduces your risk of disease, you regain energy, you save money, and you also protect the people around you. But the truth is, quitting isn’t easy.

That’s where QuitNow PRO comes in.

QuitNow PRO was born in 2011, created by a smoker who wanted to quit. Since then, we’ve grown, brought in addiction specialists, and refined our tools so you can quit tobacco for good:

YOUR EX-SMOKER STATUS
When you quit smoking, it’s important to clearly see what you’re achieving. That’s why on QuitNow PRO’s home screen you’ll see how long it’s been since you last smoked, how many cigarettes you haven’t smoked, how much money you’ve saved, and how much life you’ve regained.

COMMUNITY: THE EX-SMOKERS’ CHAT
Having a smoke-free environment is crucial when you quit. QuitNow PRO offers a chat full of people who, like you, have said goodbye to tobacco. Sharing your journey with other ex-smokers will make your path easier.

LIVE SESSIONS WITH AN EXPERT
Every month we host a live session with a smoking-cessation expert. In these sessions, the psychologist explains the best way to quit smoking and answers attendees’ questions live. These sessions are a unique opportunity to get personalized advice and resolve doubts in real time.

A COMPLETE COURSE TO QUIT SMOKING
Some people prefer a more structured method when they quit. That’s why QuitNow PRO includes a step-by-step course designed to guide you throughout the entire quitting process. It works like a digital book, but integrated inside the app.

MILESTONES: SMALL MOTIVATIONS TO QUIT SMOKING
As with any task in life, quitting is easier when you break the challenge into smaller goals. That’s why QuitNow PRO offers 80 milestones based on the cigarettes you’ve avoided, the days you’ve gone without smoking, and the money you’ve saved. This way, you can start celebrating your wins from day one.

YOUR HEALTH AS AN EX-SMOKER
In QuitNow PRO you’ll find a list of health indicators that show how your body improves day by day. These indicators are the same ones published by the World Health Organization, and we update them as soon as the WHO does.

Plus, QuitNow PRO includes other sections designed to help you on your journey to quit smoking.

QUITNOW AI
Whenever questions come up during your quitting process, you can turn to QuitNow PRO AI. It’s designed to provide clear, reliable information, based on our course and on data from the World Health Organization.

BOOKS TO HELP YOU QUIT SMOKING
Learning techniques and approaches to quit can make the process much easier. That’s why we’ve selected well-known books that can effectively help you on your path to a tobacco-free life.

ALSO ON YOUR WATCH
QuitNow PRO’s Apple Watch app and its widgets and tiles let you track your progress, see how much you’ve saved, and check your smoke-free stats right from your wrist.

Because we dedicate so much time and effort to it, we firmly believe QuitNow PRO is the best app to quit smoking. As always, there’s room for improvement—so if you have any idea to make QuitNow PRO even better, please write to us at ios@quitnow.app.

We truly hope QuitNow PRO supports you on your journey to a tobacco-free life.

Welcome to Cravio, your private guide to quitting or cutting back on sugar. If cravings tend to win on stressful days, quiet evenings, or whenever your routine breaks, Cravio gives you structure for the full day — and real support in the seconds that actually decide everything.

CRAVING ALARM
When the urge shows up, you shouldn’t have to handle it alone. Tap once and get immediate help: breathing to calm your body, honest perspective on what sugar costs you, and a clear next step instead of confusion. Cravio is built for the moment before you reach for something sweet — not just the regret after.

STREAKS THAT KEEP YOU HONEST
Your streak lives on the home screen for a reason. Every day you stay on track, you build something worth protecting. If you slip, you can log it, learn from it, and move forward without acting like the last two weeks never happened. Progress stays visible. Momentum stays real.

YOUR 90-DAY JOURNEY
Cravio maps your path across 10 phases and 90 days, from early detox to long-term freedom. You always know what phase you’re in, what’s coming next, and how far you’ve come. Your Orb evolves as you hit milestones, so the app reflects your growth even on slower days.

YOUR PERSONALIZED PLAN
After onboarding, Cravio builds a plan around you — your triggers, habits, goals, and what usually knocks you off track. See your focus right now, practical next steps, and a clear path that feels made for your life, not a generic detox checklist.

WEEKLY REPORTS
Each week, Cravio turns your real in-app activity into a short report: what went well, where cravings showed up, and what to focus on next. It’s honest feedback based on your streaks, moods, diary, and habits — so you keep improving instead of guessing.

FOOD SCAN
You already know the obvious sweets. It’s the “healthy” yogurt, the sauce, the drink you didn’t think twice about... that’s where sugar hides, and that’s what keeps the cravings coming back. Point your camera at a meal, a label, or a barcode and see it before you take the bite: added vs natural sugar, a clear score, and a lower-sugar swap when you need one.

TOOLS FOR EVERYDAY LIFE
Everything you need stays in one place:

• Breathing exercises when anxiety or cravings spike
• Soundscapes including campfire, ocean, rain, and forest
• Mood check-ins to spot patterns over time
• A short daily diary for reflection without overthinking it
• Lessons on how sugar affects energy, habits, and cravings — unlocked as you stay consistent
• Progress photos to see your journey over time
• A quote pledge when you want to recommit to your goal
• Short games when the urge hits — something for your hands and head to do for a few minutes besides eat

CRAVIO PREMIUM
Premium unlocks the full app: Craving Alarm, Food Scan, Journey, Personalized Plan, Weekly Reports, tools, and ongoing support when motivation runs low. Start with a 3-day free trial. After the trial, your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account.

WELLNESS, NOT MEDICAL CARE
Cravio is a wellness and education app. It doesn’t provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Personalized Plan text, Weekly Reports, and Food Scan results may use AI and are for general guidance only — they can be incomplete or inaccurate. If you have a health condition or questions about your diet, speak with a doctor or qualified professional before making changes.

Terms of Service: https://cravio-app.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://cravio-app.com/privacy

In the end, it’s not just about quitting sugar. It’s about the life you want when you download this app.

Finding sugar free food has never been easier! Simply download our app and scan a barcode to check if an item contains sugar.

If the product is not found or is missing ingredients you can help others by adding it directly via the app. Completely optional!

Designed with everyone in mind, our app complies with the latest accessibility requirements so everyone can use the app.

Are you trying to cut down sugar, allergic to sugar or know someone who is? Download Sugar Free Scanner now! 


How to use Sugar Free Scanner?

- Download the app
- Enable access to your camera
- Scan a barcode
- Find out within seconds if the food product is sugar free

Adverts can be disabled through an in-app subscription. The purchase will be applied to your iTunes account and will automatically renew unless cancelled before the end of your current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. For more information please see our Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy on our website:

- https://sugarfreescanner.app/terms-and-conditions
- https://sugarfreescanner.app/privacy-policy


What is a sugar free diet?

A no-sugar diet is a dietary approach that eliminates or significantly reduces the consumption of added sugars and sweeteners. This includes avoiding foods and beverages that contain sugar, such as sucrose, fructose, and high-fructose corn syrup.

The goal is to promote better health by reducing the risk of obesity, diabetes, and heart disease, which are associated with excessive sugar intake. Instead, this type of diet encourages the consumption of whole, unprocessed foods like fruits, vegetables, lean proteins, and whole grains as sources of natural sugars and carbohydrates.


Some foods you can eat on a sugar-free diet include:

- Vegetables like broccoli, cauliflower, spinach, carrots, asparagus, zucchini, and sweet potatoes
- Fruits like apples, oranges, berries, grapes, cherries, and grapefruit
- Proteins like chicken, fish, beef, tofu, and eggs
- Healthy fat sources like egg yolks, avocados, nuts, seeds, olive oil, and unsweetened yogurt


There are also a number of sugar aliases to watch out for including (but not limited to):

- glucose
- maltrose
- sucrose
- dextrose
- fructose
- lactose

A general rule of thumb is to look out for ingredients ending in "ose" - these are usually forms of sugar.

In addition to clearly labeled sugars, such as malt sugar, the substance can take on many other forms including:

- molasses
- agave
- syrups, such as corn, rice, malt, and maple
- fruit juice concentrate
- maltodextrin


Avoid artificial sweeteners

Artificial sweeteners can be anywhere from 200 to 13,000 times sweeter than real sugar. This can fool your brain into thinking that you’re actually eating sugar.

In the long run, these substitutes can trigger sugar cravings, making it harder for you to stick to your eating plan.

Common sugar substitutes include:

- Stevia
- Splenda
- Equal
- Sweet ‘N Low
- Nutrasweet

Ingredients to watch for include:

- saccharin
- aspartame
- neotame
- sucralose
- acesulfame potassium


With Sugar Free Scanner, you can easily track your sugar intake and make informed choices about your food, ensuring a healthier lifestyle while navigating dietary restrictions and food allergies.

Managing your blood sugar shouldn't feel like a second job. Blood Sugar Tracker gives you a clear, organized log of every glucose reading — so you can spot patterns, share meaningful reports with your doctor, and feel genuinely in control of your health every single day.

Whether you're living with Type 1 diabetes, Type 2 diabetes, gestational diabetes, or navigating prediabetes, this app was built around one goal: making glucose tracking effortless and informative. No cluttered interfaces. No confusing menus. Just a fast, focused experience that works the way you actually live.

▸ Log glucose readings in seconds — enter your blood sugar in mg/dL or mmol/L, tag the reading as fasting, before meal, after meal, or bedtime, and add a free-text note if something unusual happened. The entire entry takes under ten seconds.
▸ Beautiful, readable charts — view your glucose trends across the day, week, or month with interactive charts that highlight highs, lows, and time-in-range at a glance. Color coding makes patterns obvious without requiring a statistics degree.
▸ HbA1c estimation — the app calculates an estimated A1C value from your logged readings, giving you an ongoing snapshot of your long-term glucose average between lab visits.
▸ PDF export & doctor sharing — generate a clean, professionally formatted PDF report covering any date range you choose. Email it, AirDrop it, or print it directly before your next appointment. Your doctor gets the full picture in one document.
▸ Insulin & medication tracking — log your insulin doses and medications alongside each glucose entry. See at a glance how your insulin timing relates to your post-meal readings.
▸ Target range customization — set your personal glucose target range in consultation with your care team, and the app will visually flag readings that fall outside your targets.
▸ Fasting glucose tracking — dedicated fasting tags make it easy to isolate and review your morning fasting values, a key metric your doctor will want to discuss.
▸ Statistics & averages — see your 7-day, 14-day, and 30-day averages, standard deviation, and percentage of readings within range — all calculated automatically.
▸ Notes & context — add free-text notes to any entry: illness, stress, exercise, travel, or anything else that might explain an unexpected reading.

Picture a typical week: Monday morning you log your fasting glucose the moment you wake up, and the app's reminder made sure you didn't forget. After breakfast you log your carbs and the post-meal reading ninety minutes later. By Thursday you notice on the chart that your after-dinner readings are consistently elevated — something you hadn't caught before. You add a note, adjust your evening routine, and by the following week the trend line has shifted. Before your quarterly appointment, you tap Export, select the last three months, and hand your endocrinologist a PDF that shows every reading, every insulin dose, every carb count, and the estimated A1C — no scrambling through paper logs or screenshots.

Your health data belongs to you. Blood Sugar Tracker stores everything on your device. Nothing is uploaded to external servers without your explicit action. When you export a PDF or share via Apple Health, you are in complete control of what goes where. There are no hidden analytics pipelines, no advertising profiles built from your readings, and no third-party access to your health information.

Take the guesswork out of glucose management. Download Blood Sugar Tracker today and start building the clear, consistent log that you — and your doctor — have always wanted.

results.description:
Take Control of Your Smoking. Quit with Strategy.

Become the master of your cigarette habits—not a slave to cravings.

Quitting smoking isn’t just about willpower. The biggest challenge is overcoming psychological cravings. This app is designed to help you break free from mental dependence and build lasting control over your habits.

Through daily check-ins, interactive simulations, and engaging visual feedback, you’ll gradually weaken cravings, stay on track, and significantly reduce the risk of relapse.

What Is Psychological Craving?

Psychological craving—also known as mental dependence—is the strong urge to smoke driven by emotions, habits, and environment, rather than physical need for nicotine.

It often appears in situations like stress, anxiety, boredom, or social settings—even when your body doesn’t actually need nicotine.

Key Features of Psychological Craving

• Habit Triggers
Smoking is deeply tied to routines—like coffee breaks, driving, or socializing.

• Emotional Dependence
Many smokers rely on cigarettes to cope with stress, anxiety, or low mood.

• Social Influence
Being around other smokers can reinforce the urge to smoke.

• Ritual Behavior
The act of lighting and holding a cigarette can itself become a comforting habit.

Why This App Works

Psychological dependence is often harder to overcome than physical addiction. That’s why this app focuses on behavior, mindset, and habit change—not just nicotine withdrawal.

You’ll build awareness, break patterns, and regain control—step by step.

Caffeine addiction is a real thing, and not many people are willing to admit that. Since it is legal, and our culture finds no problems with it, caffeine flies under the radar as a normal way of life, but it can cause severe problems in your life, just like any other addiction.
 
Caffeine Addiction Calendar addresses the need to quit caffeine, and helps you become accountable for making the changes happen!
 
Features:
1. Use our counter to track your progress down to the second.
2. Create your own reasons to quit caffeine, or use one of our scientifically based facts about quitting.
3. Change the look and feel of the app with our skins section to personalize the app to what you want.
4. Add reasons why you would like to see yourself succeed and stop caffeine.
5. Our special panic button will help you send a text to a friend that may be able to help you and be an accountability partner.
6. Our badge system allows you to be rewarded for your success.
7. Our distractions section will help you take your mind off of caffeine and introduce you to something more positive and soothing.
8. Our built in money calculator will show you how much money you have saved since quitting
9. Our motivational quotes and testimonials will ensure that you are not alone on this process to shake your caffeine addiction. 
 
Here are our top 8 reasons to quit caffeine:
 
1. Caffeine increases your stress hormone production
 
Catecholamines (or stress hormones) are increased with caffeine consumption. This also increases your insulin production which causes inflammation which in turn ends up making you feel sluggish.
 
2. Caffeine decreases insulin sensitivity
 
When you are less sensitive to insulin, your cells are tricked into not responding appropriately to blood sugar levels. High blood sugar can lead to deterioration of your arteries and eventual increased risk of cardiovascular disease.
 
3. Increase of the release of diterpenes into your system
 
Diterpenes have been linked to increased levels of LDL, VLDL, and triglycerides. Caffeine addiction will perpetuate these issues and you will constantly have to monitor your levels.
 
4. Drinking caffeine increases your anxiety
 
Caffeine stimulates your adrenal glands, which activates your “fight or flight” response. This increases your anxiety and you may feel as if you are in a constant state of panic or nervousness.
 
5. Did we mention the financial benefits of quitting caffeine?
 
Caffeine is expensive! If you are brewing your own coffee, you still have to purchase the equipment to brew it. If you are going to Starbucks every day, you are spending money on that. Average caffeine addicts report an average savings of $2000 a year after quitting caffeine.
 
6. Stop the jitters	
 
Everyone who has drunk caffeine before knows what the jitters are. The sudden burst of energy that comes from drinking caffeine is usually not channeled properly for maximum production, and you end up just shaking because of the excess energy.
 
7. Addiction and reliance to caffeine
 
We are here because we know that caffeine addiction is a thing. Any addiction can have serious repercussions if not properly checked. If you find yourself needing caffeine at all times, this is an addiction that you need to break if you want to have a stable life.
 
8. Sleep like a baby
 
Have you ever been up at night after a day of drinking caffeine and wondered why you cannot sleep? Chances are it is the caffeine. From everything mentioned previously, you can understand why this is the case. From adrenal production to jitters, these are some things that you do not want in your life.
 

Caffeine addiction is pushed off as something that comes with the territory of being a working class citizen. Unfortunately caffeine is a very addictive substance and has similar addiction effects as any other drug. Kick your caffeine addiction by downloading Caffeine Addiction Calendar for FREE!
